title: ICON: Invariant Counterfactual Optimization with Neuro-Symbolic Priors for Text-Based Person Search

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's reliance on background contexts (e.g., pavement) rather than target features by generating counterfactual samples via semantic-driven background transplantation (Counterfactual Context Disentanglement).

Measuring the model's over-reliance on dominant visual features (e.g., bright clothing) while ignoring holistic completeness by systematically masking top salient tokens and forcing cross-modal counterfactual reconstruction.
Testing the model's sensitivity to precise bounding box positions by applying adversarial spatial interventions like discrete shifting and scaling to region proposals.
